20.en: "In the fight against Chaos, we use whatever we must to win — because failure is not an option."

38.en: Controlled use of daemonic possession creates warriors resilient to daemonic powers.

46.en: Through possession, knowledge can be plied from daemons that can ultimately be used against daemonkind or to aid the Imperium.

54.en: Protect the secrets of the Exorcists Space Marine Chapter.

76.en: Investigate daemonic activity across the Imperium and facilitate ongoing experimentations with the Exorcists Chapter. Capture daemons worth studying and return them to the fortress monastery Basilica Malefex on the Exorcist Chapter’s Homeworld of Banish.

82.en: The secretive Plutonians are Radicals who seek to harness daemonic possession in order to create formidable daemon hunters. They do not undergo possession themselves but work closely with the Exorcists, an Adeptus Astartes Chapter who specialise in fighting daemons, implanting and removing these daemons to strengthen themselves, and harnessing any forbidden knowledge they may leave behind in the formerly possessed's mind.

86.en: The first Plutonians were Ordo Malleus Inquisitors tasked with investigating the Exorcists, given they display an unusual spiritual resistance. These Inquisitors formed the radical theory that the source of this resilience was their close contact with daemons. Working with the Exorcists, Plutonians usually keep close to their homeworld of Banish in the Narasima Straits, but a task force is currently in the Macharian Sector. Rather than joining the fight for the sector’s boundaries, however, they travel from system to system as though searching, or hunting, for something. Rumour has it that a Plutonian Inquisitor travels with them, a Radical member of the Ordo Malleus who occludes the Exorcists’ activities in the sector and whose acolytes aid in the Chapter’s scouting efforts and investigations.

90.en: The Plutonians’ experimentation with daemonic possession and exorcism, which they claim leaves subjects more resistant to daemonic influence, would be enough for other Inquisitors to execute them for heresy. They harbour a particular interest in the Chapter’s Broken Ones, daemonhosts with the rare capability to hold indefinite numbers of daemons within them.

106.en: Plutonian Inquisitors must operate with the utmost secrecy — in the presence of other Inquisitors or acolytes, they would never reveal their true identity, philosophy or intentions.

114.en: Their philosophy leans on the idea that great knowledge can be obtained from unconventional means — though characteristically radical behaviour, Plutonian Inquisitors are rare open-minded characters.

122.en: Plutonian Inquisitors are used to dealing with daemons and possessed individuals, so it would take much to shatter their composure when facing such foes.

136.en: A Broken One on the Exorcists' prison-craft known as the Purgatomb has whispered omens concerning the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96]{Azynith Abyss}, speaking of a planet-devouring daemonic threat. A Librarian has been dispatched with the Broken One and Plutonian Inquisitor in tow to investigate these dire omens — characters are required to complete more discreet aspects of the investigation, chasing down local cults, Warp phenomena, and aspects of these omens.

144.en: A warband of failed Exorcist Aspirants turned to the influence of Chaos are loose in the Macharian Sector — known as the Swords of Epiphany. The Plutonian Inquisitor has been tasked with quietly recapturing them and ensuring any daemons contained within them are thoroughly exorcised. The characters must act quickly before their corruption can spread and Exorcist secrets are revealed. Their movements were last spotted on the war world of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.VeiDfnkV55kTAkRw]{Kallastin}.
